{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First few revenue values (before cleaning):")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Strip commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm conversion
print("First few cleaned revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue_clean'].head())"}
